query: For how many years is Phased Support provided to all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents?
context:

All Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents, regardless of household income and Annual Value of their residences, are automatically eligible.

MediShield Life protects Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents against large healthcare bills for life, regardless of their age or health condition.

[Document 3]
Singapore Permanent Residents (PR) are eligible to apply for Singapore citizenship two years after being granted Singapore PR status.

[Document 4]
